notes.subject: ai bilong
notes.rationale: long ples bilong אזנינו — Heb i tok 'long klaia bilong mifela miplitela harim'; Tok Pisin 'harim' i no nidim 'klaia', tasol ai (ai bilong hariap) em i gutpela klostu

notes.subject: ai bilong mifela
notes.rationale: אזנינו em i 'klaia' — Tok Pisin 'ai' i min ai tasol; klaia i 'ear'

notes.subject: Abadon na Dai
notes.rationale: Dai na Seol olgeta i no save husat ples sapra wisdim i stap — tok i hait

translation: Abadon na Dai ol i tok: Miplitela harim tok bilong en long ai bilong mifela.
